source_origin.h: historical-515-recoverable: registry_status recoverable; source identity and evidence are supported only by h references.
source_origin.q: reconciliation-356-quarantine: registry_status quarantine; source identity and evidence are supported only by q references.

v2_acquisition_readiness.not-assessed: No current endpoint was checked, no bytes were retrieved, and no v2 proof was established in this local-only lane. This field is intentionally independent of provenance_state and source_origin.

lots_impact_state.matched: lots_impact_ref resolves to exactly one same-slug logical-lots registry row.
lots_impact_state.no-match: No same-slug logical-lots collection exists; lots_impact_ref names the logical-lots registry root and no link is inferred.

rollout_policy.v2: No rollout; complete current-source validation and v2 proof in a separately authorized run.
rollout_policy.owner: No rollout; owner-review the recorded linkage, then validate/reacquire and emit v2 proof in a separately authorized run.
rollout_policy.link: No rollout; human-confirm the historical identity-to-collection linkage, then validate/reacquire and emit v2 proof in a separately authorized run.
rollout_policy.confirm: No rollout; human-confirm municipality, vintage, sheet/layer coverage, and ownership before any authorized v2 proof work.
rollout_policy.manual: No rollout; manual historical producer/operator archive recovery is required. Do not infer a source from generic regulation or homepage material.

row_encoding: Every row is a positional array in row_fields order. Source identity and evidence are reference-only; a source_identity_ref resolving to null is retained as null and no source is synthesized.
